B1.name: Skin Realism
B1.instruction: Keep skin true to life: fine pores, faint natural texture, and soft natural blush remain visible; avoid airbrushing, plastic sheen, or waxy porcelain finishes.

B2.name: Identity Lock
B2.instruction: Maintain exact facial identity from reference: precise bone structure, eye shape and spacing, nose contour, lip volume, jawline, hairline, and skin undertone; do not re-beautify or alter ethnic appearance.

B3.name: Scene Lock
B3.instruction: Fix background environment, ambient lighting, color temperature, and camera perspective strictly identical to the original image.

B4.name: Single Change
B4.instruction: Only modify the designated target attribute; all other elements including attire, background, posture, and lighting must remain completely unaltered.

B5.name: Full Body Framing
B5.instruction: Camera pulled back to show full body from head to feet with balanced margins above head and below shoes; subject occupies roughly 60-70% of frame height.

B6.name: Angle Lexicon
B6.instruction: Camera angle explicitly determines perspective: low angle expands legs and height; bird's-eye emphasizes crown and shoulders; 3/4 profile rotates body 45 degrees; profile view provides clean 90-degree silhouette.

B7.name: Phone Camera Realism
B7.instruction: Subtle mobile camera realism: minor optical handheld softness, candid off-center framing, faint highlights bloom, natural dynamic range, and authentic everyday texture without clinical studio perfection.

B8.name: Retro Flash
B8.instruction: On-camera direct flash illuminates subject while background falls into deeper shadow; hard drop shadow behind subject, slight warm-yellow color cast, gentle grain, and nostalgic compact digicam exposure.

B9.name: Dreamy Bloom
B9.instruction: Luminous window backlight with ethereal bloom, creamy softened highlights, gentle atmospheric haze, pastel muted palette, and lowered contrast.

B10.name: Grid Lock
B10.instruction: Exact panel count and uniform grid layout: equal cell dimensions and margins, single role per cell, consistent scale and lighting across all frames.

B11.name: Pure White Background
B11.instruction: Uniform pure white background (#FFFFFF) with zero color cast, no vignette, and only a soft natural contact grounding shadow directly beneath the item.

B12.name: Apparel Fidelity
B12.instruction: Preserve garment silhouette, tailored drape, seam lines, fastenings, pockets, authentic material weight, and exact colorways without arbitrary embellishments.

B13.name: Worn Realism
B13.instruction: Natural fabric folds, wrinkles, and compression reacting realistically to human posture and gravity; seamless interaction with body contours without floating or pasted appearance.

B14.name: Composite Integration
B14.instruction: Inserted stylized or source elements must respect scene perspective, lighting direction, ambient reflections, edge blur, and contact shadows for natural scene cohesion.

B15.name: Text Policy
B15.instruction: Zero arbitrary text, logos, or watermarks unless explicitly specified in quotes; any requested text must be rendered accurately in designated empty space without obscuring key subjects.

B16.name: Anatomy Negative
B16.instruction: Strict anatomical correctness: exactly five fingers per hand, correct joint articulation, symmetrical facial landmarks, no duplicated limbs, and natural posture.

B17.name: Non-Destructive Overlay
B17.instruction: Do not regenerate or alter the underlying photograph; apply hand-drawn doodles and annotations purely as an overlay in negative space.

B18.name: Quality Suffix Caution
B18.instruction: Avoid generic quality buzzwords that induce artificial plastic textures or over-sharpening; emphasize photographic realism through physical optical properties.

B19.name: Portrait Lighting Lexicon
B19.instruction: Apply classical portrait lighting schemas: Rembrandt triangle, loop shadow, butterfly under nose, split side light, or gentle clamshell beauty lighting as requested.

B20.name: Failure Recovery
B20.instruction: If generation diverges from reference identity, reinforce facial feature constraints; if skin appears synthetic, re-inject micro-texture and grain; if elements distort, fallback to incremental step edits.

excluded.name: Video-only Prompts
excluded.reason: Video generation prompts (e.g. lip-sync, 180 pan, 90 side view, wipe transitions) are excluded from static image generation catalog.

excluded.name: Text Analysis and Meta Prompts
excluded.reason: Analytical meta prompts used for image reverse-engineering and prompt synthesis rather than direct image generation.
